title: Rolling Ahead Diffusion for Traffic Scene Simulation

control_signal.value: No user steering signal; model conditions on observed agent states, map and agent dimensions. Test-time conditioning is listed as future work.

control_mechanism.value: Not a control method: a sliding window of partially denoised future steps (rolling diffusion) with self-attention over time and agents and cross-attention to map features.

base_model.value: Rolling diffusion model with EDM-style noise schedule and Heun sampler, transformer denoiser; compared against DJINN (MPC) and a diffusion autoregressive model.

metrics.value: minSceneADE, minSceneFDE, miss rate; collision rate against an adversarial (replay-slowed) agent; prediction time per sample.

controllability_evidence.value: Reactivity test with a slowed adversarial agent: collision rate RoAD-15 0.019, RoAD-20 0.024, AR 0.016, DJINN 0.052; prediction time 0.34, 0.20, 0.68, 0.07 min.

stated_limitations.value: Partial denoising of future states limits adaptation to perturbations from agents under another planner; larger windows lower reactivity. Test-time conditioning is deferred to future work.

notes: Paper is about reactive, efficient closed-loop simulation, not controllable generation; the reactivity test is not a controllability test. Workshop paper.
